scripts.dev: pnpm run build && concurrently -k -n tsc,api "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch dist/server.js"
scripts.smoke:advisor: curl -sS -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-3000}/advisor/chat" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"userId":"smoke","message":"用一句话打个招呼","allowSearch":false}' | node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'); try { const j=JSON.parse(d); console.log(j.answer||j); } catch(e){ console.log(d); process.exit(1);}"
